spec.behavior: Read a deterministic EDB1 binary telemetry stream of fixed-size frames, checksum every input byte, retain fixed scalar state for four channels, and report valid-frame counts plus sample, energy, load, and tick aggregates.
spec.record: Header EDB1 and little-endian frame fields channel:u8, flags:u8, sample:u16, tick:u32, energy:u16, load:u16. Frames with flags=0 are valid; channel counts and aggregates include valid frames only.
spec.memory: Every implementation loads the identical generated 12,000,008-byte input blob before timing and processing; the reducer state is fixed and uses no maps, strings, or growing collections: only four channel counters and fixed scalar aggregates.
